verdict.rationale: Orb documents managed daily data exports of resource types to any destination (orb-docs-12) and revenue/financial exports (orb-docs-7), which could cover subscriptions/invoices/usage, but there is no evidence describing exporting stored payment methods or any outbound migration path — the only migration content covers importing customers *into* Orb from Stripe (orb-docs-13, orb-docs-14), not leaving Orb for another provider. Missing for 10: explicit payment-method export/portability, confirmation that exports cover all three record types comprehensively, and documentation of an outbound/offboarding migration process.
